Callout.Name: Subway Disturbance
Callout.Advisory: Two males arguing, staff asking for someone to attend.

Script.Line: One man going along the platform shouting and pushing people.
We have held the trains so nobody is stuck down here with him.
He has gone down onto the track. He is on the track now.

Lines.Approach: Two of them on the platform and the staff have had enough. It has not turned violent.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
